title: Backend Developer
description: Designs, implements, and maintains robust server-side APIs, database schemas, and microservice architectures.

requirements.description: Core backend scripting and application development language.
High-throughput asynchronous REST API routing and request validation.
Relational data modeling, ACID transactions, and query optimization.
Containerizing backend services for reproducible deployments.
RESTful resource design, HTTP status conventions, and OpenAPI specs.
Distributed cache layer to minimize database load and accelerate responses.
Collaborative version control and feature branch workflows.
Automated testing fixtures, test-driven development, and regressions safety.

title: Data Scientist
description: Extracts actionable predictive insights from complex datasets using statistical modeling, feature engineering, and machine learning.

requirements.description: Primary data manipulation and statistical programming language.
Structured data cleaning, transformations, joins, and aggregations.
Vectorized computations, matrix operations, and array manipulation.
Training classification, regression, clustering models, and cross-validation.
Hypothesis testing, distributions, significance testing, and experimental design.
Complex analytical queries, window functions, and data extraction.
Communicating trends, correlations, and model metrics to stakeholders.

title: Machine Learning Engineer
description: Bridges the gap between data science and scalable systems by deploying, optimizing, and monitoring deep learning and ML models in production.

requirements.description: Base language for ML research and pipeline engineering.
Building and fine-tuning neural network architectures and autograd computations.
Loss functions, gradient descent optimization, regularization, and model validation.
Model registry, experiment tracking, versioning, and continuous model deployment.
Packaging models into containerized microservices for GPU/CPU inference.
Low-latency REST inference servers for model scoring.
Text embedding representations, sequence modeling, and language applications.
Optimizing algorithmic complexity and throughput for large-scale data ingestion.

title: Full Stack Developer
description: Develops seamless end-to-end web applications across modern interactive frontends and scalable backend APIs.

requirements.description: Type-safe modern application code on both client and server.
Component hierarchy, reactive state hooks, and client UX.
Server-side rendering, routing, server actions, and fullstack orchestration.
Backend services, asynchronous I/O, and server middleware.
Structured persistent relational storage and schema design.
Rapid modern UI styling and responsive web layouts.
API contracts, JSON communication, and endpoint security.
Version control, code review branches, and collaboration.

title: Cloud & DevOps Engineer
description: Automates continuous integration, infrastructure provisioning, and production cloud operations with high reliability.

requirements.description: Standardized container packaging and multi-stage build optimization.
Cluster orchestration, pod auto-scaling, ingress controllers, and configs.
Building robust automated test and release pipelines.
Kernel parameters, process debugging, shell administration, and systemd.
Core cloud infrastructure: VPC, IAM, EC2, S3, and load balancers.
Declarative Infrastructure-as-Code state management and module creation.
Prometheus metric alerts, Grafana dashboards, and system health telemetry.
